ayahs.arabicText: نٓ وَ الْقَلَمِ وَ مَا یَسْطُرُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: Nun. By the pen and what the scribes write.

ayahs.arabicText: مَاۤ اَنْتَ بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ بِمَجْنُوْنٍۚ
ayahs.translation: By your Lord's Grace, you are not afflicted with madness,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنَّ لَكَ لَاَجْرًا غَیْرَ مَمْنُوْنٍۚ
ayahs.translation: and surely yours shall be a never-ending reward,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنَّكَ لَعَلٰى خُلُقٍ عَظِیْمٍ
ayahs.translation: and you are certainly on the most exalted standard of moral excellence.

ayahs.arabicText: فَسَتُبْصِرُ وَ یُبْصِرُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: So you will soon see, and they too will see,

ayahs.arabicText: بِاَىیِّكُمُ الْمَفْتُوْنُ
ayahs.translation: which of you is afflicted with madness.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ اَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ ضَلَّ عَنْ سَبِیْلِهٖ١۪ وَ هُوَ اَعْلَمُ بِالْمُهْتَدِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Surely your Lord knows well those who have strayed from His Way just as He knows well those who are on the Right Way.

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَا تُطِعِ الْمُكَذِّبِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Do not, then, yield to those who reject the Truth, decrying it as false;

ayahs.arabicText: وَدُّوْا لَوْ تُدْهِنُ فَیُدْهِنُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: they would wish you to be pliant so that they too may be pliant.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَا تُطِعْ كُلَّ حَلَّافٍ مَّهِیْنٍۙ
ayahs.translation: And do not yield to any contemptible swearer,

ayahs.arabicText: هَمَّازٍ مَّشَّآءٍۭ بِنَمِیْمٍۙ
ayahs.translation: the fault-finder who goes around slandering,

ayahs.arabicText: مَّنَّاعٍ لِّلْخَیْرِ مُعْتَدٍ اَثِیْمٍۙ
ayahs.translation: the hinderer of good, the transgressor, the sinful;

ayahs.arabicText: عُتُلٍّۭ بَعْدَ ذٰلِكَ زَنِیْمٍۙ
ayahs.translation: the coarse-grained, and above all mean and ignoble;

ayahs.arabicText: اَنْ كَانَ ذَا مَالٍ وَّ بَنِیْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: (who so acts) simply because he has wealth and sons,

ayahs.arabicText: اِذَا تُتْلٰى عَلَیْهِ اٰیٰتُنَا قَالَ اَسَاطِیْرُ الْاَوَّلِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: and whenever Our verses are rehearsed to him, he says: “These are fairy- tales of times gone by.”

ayahs.arabicText: سَنَسِمُهٗ عَلَى الْخُرْطُوْمِ
ayahs.translation: Soon shall We brand him on his snout.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّا بَلَوْنٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَاۤ اَصْحٰبَ الْجَنَّةِ١ۚ اِذْ اَقْسَمُوْا لَیَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: We have put them [i.e., the Makkans] to test even as We put to test the owners of the orchard when they vowed that they would gather the fruit of their orchard in the morning,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَا یَسْتَثْنُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: without making any allowance (for the will of Allah).

ayahs.arabicText: فَطَافَ عَلَیْهَا طَآئِفٌ مِّنْ رَّبِّكَ وَ هُمْ نَآئِمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Thereupon a calamity from your Lord passed over it while they were asleep,

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَصْبَحَتْ كَالصَّرِیْمِۙ
ayahs.translation: and so by morning the orchard lay as though it had been fully harvested.

ayahs.arabicText: فَتَنَادَوْا مُصْبِحِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: At daybreak they called out to one another:

ayahs.arabicText: اَنِ اغْدُوْا عَلٰى حَرْثِكُمْ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ صٰرِمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: “Hurry to your orchard if you would gather its fruit.”

ayahs.arabicText: فَانْطَلَقُوْا وَ هُمْ یَتَخَافَتُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: So off they went, whispering to one another:

ayahs.arabicText: اَنْ لَّا یَدْخُلَنَّهَا الْیَوْمَ عَلَیْكُمْ مِّسْكِیْنٌۙ
ayahs.translation: “No destitute person shall enter it today.”

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ غَدَوْا عَلٰى حَرْدٍ قٰدِرِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: They went forth early, believing that they had the power (to gather the fruit).

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَمَّا رَاَوْهَا قَالُوْۤا اِنَّا لَضَآلُّوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: But as soon as they beheld the orchard, (they cried out): “We have certainly lost the way;

ayahs.arabicText: بَلْ نَحْنُ مَحْرُوْمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: rather, we are utterly ruined.”

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ اَوْسَطُهُمْ اَلَمْ اَقُلْ لَّكُمْ لَوْ لَا تُسَبِّحُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: The best among them said: “Did I not say to you: why do you not give glory to (your Lord)?”

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا سُبْحٰنَ رَبِّنَاۤ اِنَّا كُنَّا ظٰلِمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: They cried out: “Glory be to our Lord! Certainly we were sinners.”

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلٰى بَعْضٍ یَّتَلَاوَمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Then they began to reproach one another.

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا یٰوَیْلَنَاۤ اِنَّا كُنَّا طٰغِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: They said: “Woe to us! We had indeed transgressed.

ayahs.arabicText: عَسٰى رَبُّنَاۤ اَنْ یُّبْدِلَنَا خَیْرًا مِّنْهَاۤ اِنَّاۤ اِلٰى رَبِّنَا رٰغِبُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Maybe our Lord will give us a better orchard in its place; to our Lord do we penitently turn.”

ayahs.arabicText: كَذٰلِكَ الْعَذَابُ١ؕ وَ لَعَذَابُ الْاٰخِرَةِ اَكْبَرُ١ۘ لَوْ كَانُوْا یَعْلَمُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Such is the chastisement; and the chastisement of the Hereafter is assuredly even greater, if only they knew.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِیْنَ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنّٰتِ النَّعِیْمِ
ayahs.translation: Surely the God-fearing shall have Gardens of bliss with their Lord.

ayahs.arabicText: اَفَنَجْعَلُ الْمُسْلِمِیْنَ كَالْمُجْرِمِیْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: What! Shall We treat those who have submitted (to Our command) like those who have acted as criminals?

ayahs.arabicText: مَا لَكُمْ١ٙ كَیْفَ تَحْكُمُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: What is the matter with you? How ill do you judge!

ayahs.arabicText: اَمْ لَكُمْ كِتٰبٌ فِیْهِ تَدْرُسُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: Or do you have a Book wherein you read

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ لَكُمْ فِیْهِ لَمَا تَخَیَّرُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: that (in the Hereafter) you shall have all that you choose for yourselves?

ayahs.arabicText: اَمْ لَكُمْ اَیْمَانٌ عَلَیْنَا بَالِغَةٌ اِلٰى یَوْمِ الْقِیٰمَةِ١ۙ اِنَّ لَكُمْ لَمَا تَحْكُمُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: Or have We sworn a covenant with you which We are bound to keep till the Day of Resurrection, (a covenant requiring that whatever you ordain for yourselves shall be yours)?

ayahs.arabicText: سَلْهُمْ اَیُّهُمْ بِذٰلِكَ زَعِیْمٌۚۛ
ayahs.translation: Ask them: “Which of them can guarantee that?

ayahs.arabicText: اَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَآءُ١ۛۚ فَلْیَاْتُوْا بِشُرَكَآئِهِمْ اِنْ كَانُوْا صٰدِقِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Or has something been guaranteed by any of those whom they associate with Allah in His Divinity?” If so, let them bring forth their associates, if they are truthful.

ayahs.arabicText: یَوْمَ یُكْشَفُ عَنْ سَاقٍ وَّ یُدْعَوْنَ اِلَى السُّجُوْدِ فَلَا یَسْتَطِیْعُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: On the Day when the dreadful calamity will unfold, when people will be summoned to prostrate themselves, and yet they will not be able to prostrate.

ayahs.arabicText: خَاشِعَةً اَبْصَارُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ١ؕ وَ قَدْ كَانُوْا یُدْعَوْنَ اِلَى السُّجُوْدِ وَ هُمْ سٰلِمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Their eyes shall be downcast and ignominy shall overwhelm them. For when they were safe and sound, they were summoned to prostrate themselves, (and they refused).

ayahs.arabicText: فَذَرْنِیْ وَ مَنْ یُّكَذِّبُ بِهٰذَا الْحَدِیْثِ١ؕ سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُمْ مِّنْ حَیْثُ لَا یَعْلَمُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: So leave Me, (O Prophet), to deal with him who gives the lie to this Discourse. We shall draw them little by little (to their undoing) in a way that they will not know.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اُمْلِیْ لَهُمْ١ؕ اِنَّ كَیْدِیْ مَتِیْنٌ
ayahs.translation: I am giving them a respite. Great is My scheme!

ayahs.arabicText: اَمْ تَسْئَلُهُمْ اَجْرًا فَهُمْ مِّنْ مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: Or are you asking them for some compensation so that they feel burdened with debt?

ayahs.arabicText: اَمْ عِنْدَهُمُ الْغَیْبُ فَهُمْ یَكْتُبُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Or do they have any knowledge of the Unseen which they are now writing down?

ayahs.arabicText: فَاصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَ لَا تَكُنْ كَصَاحِبِ الْحُوْتِ١ۘ اِذْ نَادٰى وَ هُوَ مَكْظُوْمٌؕ
ayahs.translation: So bear with patience until the Judgement of your Lord comes, and do not belike the man in the fish (i.e., Jonah) who called out, choking with grief:

ayahs.arabicText: لَوْ لَاۤ اَنْ تَدٰرَكَهٗ نِعْمَةٌ مِّنْ رَّبِّهٖ لَنُبِذَ بِالْعَرَآءِ وَ هُوَ مَذْمُوْمٌ
ayahs.translation: had his Lord not bestowed His favour upon him, he would have been cast upon that barren shore (and would have remained there) in disgrace.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاجْتَبٰىهُ رَبُّهٗ فَجَعَلَهٗ مِنَ الصّٰلِحِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: But his Lord exalted him, and included him among His righteous servants.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنْ یَّكَادُ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا لَیُزْلِقُوْنَكَ بِاَبْصَارِهِمْ لَمَّا سَمِعُوا الذِّكْرَ وَ یَقُوْلُوْنَ اِنَّهٗ لَمَجْنُوْنٌۘ
ayahs.translation: When the unbelievers hear this Exhortation, they look at you as though they would knock you off your feet with their (hostile) glances. They say: “Surely he is afflicted with madness”;

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَا هُوَ اِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعٰلَمِیْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: although this is nothing but an Exhortation (to goodness) for everyone in the world.
